items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I played with Al Grey and I played with Vic. We played together.

ctx.x: Who'd you play with this year?

I played with Al Grey and I played with Vic. We played together. And there's another guy up there that plays with the World's Greatest Jazz Band now, George Masso. He's a good trombone player. I played with George. And I really enjoyed it, you know. It was fun. It was a fun thing. It got to cooking up there because they had a lot of good rhythm players up there.
Who else was there this year? I didn't see the Lineup (inaudible)...

items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: But he brags to me about it.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know several pretty strong trumpet players who have got...

Trombone, too. Don't forget that. There's a very famous one. I won't name the name, because he probably don't want nobody to know that he... But he brags to me about it. But maybe he don't want anybody to know. So there you go. He ain't got a child in the yard up there, but he still... [LAUGHS] You know what I mean? He still makes the scene, man! And beautiful. Sounds as good as he did, if not better.
Do you think maybe off the record we could say who he was?
